essence: Even immense lifespan does not suffice to exhaust scripture.
Therefore one should discern and grasp the essence, like a swan separating milk from water.
Therefore one should abandon all scriptures like chaff once their essential purpose is fulfilled.
Thus, for the knower of truth there is no purpose served by scripture.
Liberation comes only from knowledge and not by any other means.
